reviewItem.question: Does "Content-Type Auto-Detection: In v3, the `Content-Type` header is not auto-detected anymore when it is not set by the backend" mean a change to protocol-behavior:traefik|name=content-type-auto-detection (behavior-changed)?

change.before: "Content-Type header was auto-detected when not set by the backend"
change.after: "Content-Type header is not auto-detected when not set by the backend"

proposed.statement: In Traefik 3.0, automatic Content-Type header detection is removed when the backend does not set the Content-Type header; the ContentType middleware must be explicitly used to enable this detection.
